definitions.meaning: A family, household, house; also a hide of land

quotations.english: if he have a hide of land

source_text: híwisc, hígwisc, es; n. A family, household, house; also a hide of land [v. híd] :-- Fæder hiogwuisc, hiowisc, hiuwisc paterfamilias, Lk. Skt. Lind. Rush. 12, 39: 13, 25: 14, 21. Gif hé hæbbe híwisc landes if he have a hide of land, L. Wg. 7; Th. i. 186, 13 [cf. l. 23]. On Cotenes-
